author: Nelev
body:
The record used to be fetched once, before the model was asked, and pasted into the prompt. The model got the five passages nearest the raw question whether or not those were the ones it needed, and had no way to ask for anything else.

It now has `search_record` as a tool.

## What changed

- **`main.py`** — declares the tool (flat schema, as the Responses API wants it), executes any `function_call` the model returns, pairs the result back by `call_id`, and calls again to get the answer.
- **The second call is guarded.** It runs only when a tool result was appended. Unconditionally, a plain "thanks" paid for two rounds and re-asked the question with the first answer already in the input.
- **`patient_id` comes from `record_id(userId)`**, never from the model's arguments — those are generated text, and a message claiming a different record id must not become a read of somebody else's chart.
- **`assistant_general_prompt.py`** — describes the tool and when reaching for it is warranted.
- **`tests/test_main.py`** — the stub moves to the Responses shape, where `output_text` is what the route reads.
- **`rag_pipeline/run.py`** — the probe query returns ten passages rather than one.

## Verified against the live model

| Question | Round 1 | Round 2 | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| "what episodes are in my record?" | `function_call` | `message` | S5 / high, episodes listed |
| "thanks, that is all" | `message` | *skipped* | S5 / high, one round |
| "I took ibuprofen an hour ago and my lips are swelling" | two `function_call`s | `message` | S1 / high, emergency care, names the known ibuprofen hypersensitivity |

The last one is the one that matters: two searches in a single round, both executed and paired back, and an answer grounded in an allergy the model could only have learned from the tool — there is no record in the prompt any more.

`ruff format` and `ruff check` clean, 81 tests pass.

## Known gap

There is no third round. If the model answers a tool result by asking to search again, `output_text` is empty and the reply falls through to `ASSISTANT_UNAVAILABLE` at S2 — safe, but not an answer. Wrapping the two rounds in a bounded loop closes it.
